questions: Are you using WiFi or LAN?
Is the issue happening on all devices or only one device?
How many devices are connected?
Have you restarted the router?
solutionSteps: Restart the router and wait 2 minutes.
Turn off router power for 30 seconds and turn it on again.
Check if the internet cable is properly connected.
Place the router in an open area, away from walls and metal objects.
Reduce connected devices if too many users are connected.
escalationMessage: If the issue continues, please contact your nearest Excel Customer Support Point: https://www.excelbd.com/support/

questions: Is the WAN/Internet light on?
Is your ISP line active?
Did you restart the router and modem/ONU?
solutionSteps: Check the WAN/Internet cable.
Restart the router and ONU/modem.
Confirm the ISP bill and line status.
Check whether the WAN/Internet light becomes stable.
escalationMessage: If internet is still not working, contact your nearest Excel Customer Support Point: https://www.excelbd.com/support/

questions: How far are you from the router?
Does WiFi disconnect on all devices?
Is the router placed near walls or metal objects?
solutionSteps: Restart the router.
Move the router to an open place.
Reduce connected devices.
Change WiFi channel if the router supports it.
Update router firmware if available.
escalationMessage: If WiFi still disconnects, contact Excel support: https://www.excelbd.com/support/

questions: Where is the router placed?
How many walls are between you and the router?
Are you using 2.4GHz or 5GHz WiFi?
solutionSteps: Place the router in a central open area.
Keep it away from walls and metal objects.
Use 2.4GHz for longer range.
Use an extender or mesh if the area is large.
escalationMessage: For range planning, contact Excel support: https://www.excelbd.com/support/

questions: What is your ISP connection type?
Do you have username/password from ISP?
Can you open the router admin page?
solutionSteps: Connect ISP cable to WAN port.
Open the router admin page.
Select the correct connection type.
Enter ISP username/password if needed.
Set WiFi name and password, then save.
escalationMessage: If setup fails, contact Excel support: https://www.excelbd.com/support/

questions: What is the router model?
Do you know the hardware version?
Is the router power stable?
solutionSteps: Download firmware only from the official brand website.
Match exact model and hardware version.
Keep power stable during update.
Update from the router admin panel.
Restart router after update.
escalationMessage: If unsure, do not update manually. Contact Excel support: https://www.excelbd.com/support/

questions: Can you log in to the router admin page?
Do you want to change WiFi password or reset the router?
solutionSteps: Open router admin page.
Log in with admin credentials.
Go to Wireless/WiFi settings.
Set new WiFi password and save.
Reconnect devices with the new password.
escalationMessage: If password reset fails, contact Excel support: https://www.excelbd.com/support/
